research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2352, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1924 refines in place under this same id. documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-1842 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.symbolic_location: 2109 S. Prairie Avenue, parcel prairie_2109 (data/street_grid/1904.json), east side of Prairie Avenue, Prairie Avenue, 20th to 22nd Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 35).
position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 34.500, v -5.000 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Rotation 179.312 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.

derivation.reason: The four derivation methods re-derive from the 1835 files; this position is re-derived from the traced sheet and the 1904 parcel by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py --check instead.

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front), widened to 5.5 m along the front because the fitted strip was narrower than any house of the avenue (T-2690). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: '3B' printed on the 1911 sheet: 3 full storeys.

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: The Robert Roloson house: the register keeps its veranda and mansard tower inferred only once the Armour photograph's orientation agrees, so the draft is the 'constrained plain masonry envelope' it names, a hip over three storeys with the stone front and the one-storey frame veranda the sheet draws on the north and west. T-1924 decides the tower. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 527464777 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
